product_metadata.title: Talented Kitchen 12 Magnetic Spice Jars for Refrigerator with 3 Metal Wall Bases, 269 Preprinted Seasoning Labels, 2 Styles, 1 Cooking Conversion Chart, for 3 oz Containers
features: Includes: 12 magnetic spice tins with lids and adhesive discs, 269 labels in 2 styles, 125 clear seasoning stickers, 144 chalkboard-style labels, and, 3 wall base plates, and 1 conversion chart
Most Common Spices: Customize the magnetic spice containers with the preprinted, water-resistant vinyl seasoning label stickers in 2 styles; spice labels feature the most commonly used seasonings
Sift-and-Pour Lids: The magnetic spice jars for refrigerator have transparent shaker lids to quickly identify contents inside; add spice gradually with the small sift holes
Space-Saving Design: Our magnet spice organization for fridge also attaches to most flat metal surfaces; they are ideal for apartments, RVs, dorm rooms, and those who appreciate a minimalist kitchen
Practical Size: Talented Kitchen spice jars are 2.5x2 inches; wall plates are 12.5x3 inches; rectangular stickers are 1.5x0.5 inches; black labels are 1-inch each; conversion chart is 5x7 inches
